name: @memcoai/memco
description: Node.js SDK for Memco Shared Memory.
author: Memco Labs, Inc.

scripts.build:esm: tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && cp src/internal/moduleDir.esm.js dist/esm/src/internal/moduleDir.js && cp src/internal/moduleDir.d.ts dist/esm/src/internal/moduleDir.d.ts
scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && cp src/internal/moduleDir.cjs.js dist/cjs/src/internal/moduleDir.js && cp src/internal/moduleDir.d.ts dist/cjs/src/internal/moduleDir.d.ts && printf '{"type":"commonjs"}\n' > dist/cjs/package.json
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.build:test: rm -rf build/js && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && cp src/internal/moduleDir.esm.js build/js/src/internal/moduleDir.js
scripts.coverage: npm run build:test && mkdir -p coverage && node --test --enable-source-maps --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=95 --test-coverage-functions=95 --test-coverage-branches=90 --test-coverage-exclude=build/js/client/** --test-coverage-exclude=build/js/examples/** --test-coverage-exclude=build/js/tests/** --test-coverage-exclude=build/js/src/types.js --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info 'build/js/tests/**/*.test.js'
